item.title: What Happens to the Human Body on Hunger Strike? | Harriet Williamson
item.description: The Palestine Action-linked hunger strikers are in the ‘red zone’, according to medical professionals. What are the risks of prolonged hunger strike and the most common reasons for death?

item.description: A worker for Sense got sacked being arrested for showing support for Palestine Action. After a Novara Media report and union solidarity, she got her job back.

item.title: Protests Break Out in Iran As Trump Considers Regime Change
item.description: The US is threatening regime change in Iran amid anti-government protests. Ayatollah Khamenei has tried to dismiss these as the work of outsiders. Plus: Donald Trump tells the New York Times that international law won’t restrain him, and Keir Starmer threatens to ban Elon Musk’s X over abuse images. With Michael Walker, Ash Sarkar and Eskandar Sadeghi-Boroujerdi.…

item.description: Britain’s most-watched TV show takes place in a castle built by an opium trader surrounded by destructive non-native pine plantations. This is Scotland without Scots, writes Adam Ramsay - and English people can’t get enough of it.
